description: This file contains unit tests for safe reading operations from file handles, specifically testing the behavior when file handles are closed and reading data incrementally from pipes.

classes.name: FileHandleSafeReadTests
classes.description: A struct containing test methods for validating safe reading behaviors from file handles.

methods.name: read to end safely returns empty for closed handle
methods.description: Tests that reading to the end safely from a closed handle returns an empty Data object.

methods.name: read safely up to count returns empty for closed handle
methods.description: Tests that reading up to a specified count from a closed handle returns an empty Data object.

methods.name: read to end safely reads pipe contents
methods.description: Verifies that reading to the end from a pipe correctly retrieves the written data.

methods.name: read safely up to count reads incrementally
methods.description: Ensures that reading data in chunks from a pipe produces the expected segmented output.
